key_insight: QuFrame enables real-time Pauli frame tracking for fault-tolerant quantum control, closing the QEC loop within a 1 μs cycle while sustaining QPU-rate throughput.
engineering_relevance: It addresses time-critical dependencies between error-corrected measurements and non-Clifford gate execution, where software-only deferred corrections are insufficient.
method: QuFrameISA separates instruction execution from continuous Pauli frame management.
Per-qubit Instruction Resolution Engines use a single table lookup, while a Pauli Frame Management Unit supports independent, lock-free concurrent commits.
An asynchronous primary decoder is paired with an on-chip fallback decoder and hardware reconciliation of divergent updates.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports 144 ns fallback decoding and a 1 μs QEC-loop deadline without degraded logical error rates, but provides no evaluation setup or benchmark details.
watch_item: Scalability and timing guarantees require validation under realistic decoder workloads, communication delays, and hardware resource constraints.
paper_title: QuFrame: Pauli Frame Tracking for Fault-Tolerant Quantum Control
